text.en:
Amendment to EO No. 24. Paragraph 3, Section 3 of EO No. 24 is
hereby amended to read as follows:
THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

"The composition of the Cluster shall be as follows:
Secretary, Department of Public Works and Highways
The Executive Secretary
The Cabinet Secretary
Head, Presidential Management Staff
Secretary, Department of the Interior and Local Government
Secretary, Department of Budget and Management
Secretary, National Economic and Development Authority
Secretary, Department of Transportation
Secretary, Department of Finance
Secretary, Department of Information and Communications
Technology
Secretary, Department of Trade and Industry
Secretary, Department of Agriculture
Secretary, Department of Health
Secretary, Department of Social Welfare and Development
Secretary, Department of Education
Secretary, Department of Tourism
President, Bases Conversion and Development Authority
Secretariat: National Economic and Development Authority"

Unaffected provisions. Except as expressly modified by this Order,
all other provisions of EO No. 24 shall remain in full force and effect.

Repeal. All other issuances, orders, rules and regulations or parts
thereof inconsistent with the provisions of this Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

Separability. If any provision of this Executive Order is declared
invalid or unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain valid
and subsisting.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon its
publication in the Official Gazette or a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 25th day of
our Lord. Two Thousand Nineteen.
, in the year of
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary
